name: Give
overview: Scripture teaches that giving is an expression of righteousness and mercy, as the righteous give while the wicked withhold (Psalms 37:21). God calls His people to bring their tithes faithfully, promising abundant blessings in return (Malachi 3:10). Giving is not only a duty but a blessing, for it is more blessed to give than to receive, and generous giving results in receiving in good measure, overflowing (Luke 6:38; Acts 20:35). Furthermore, doing good and sharing with others are sacrifices pleasing to God (Hebrews 13:16), highlighting the heart of giving as an act of worship and obedience.
